status_note: All eleven coverage projections - the five original insertion projections and the six TRANSFORM-MULTIEQUAL-INSERT-RESIDUAL-0001 branches (op_preexisting retarget/resize, nested follow convergence, INDIRECT inherit/mark both arms, misaligned-piece throw with pre-exception partial state, output==nullptr, BlockBasic::setOrder renumber boundary) - are byte-identical MATCH against the locked 12.0.4 oracle. The residual TODO is resolved; observations outside this fixture's six branches are recorded in out_of_scope_observations.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: TransformOp.follow refers to the exact placeholder whose replacement supplies the parent block; replacement/output/input identities are preserved and compared through stable encounter labels. createReplacement mutates each TransformOp.replacement; the op_preexisting arm mutates the original PcodeOp in place (opcode, input slot count) and never re-inserts it; when output is non-null the paired TransformVar.replacement/def relationship is materialized; inheritIndirect reads the source INDIRECT's PcodeOp/Varnode flags and specialHandling writes them onto the replacement via Funcdata::markIndirectCreation.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: TransformManager::createOps visits newOps once in list/arena creation order, then repeatedly visits the same order until no follow remains; follow chains built via newOp always point at earlier-created placeholders, so a nested chain (top->mid->follow) resolves mid-first then top within one pass on both sides. Two MULTIEQUALs are each inserted at block begin, so the later-created op precedes the earlier one; non-PHI ops insert immediately before the same target and retain creation order; the preexisting arm's shrink/clear/grow loops walk op->numInput() from the last slot down and from slot 0 up exactly as transform.cc:231-236; createVarnodes walks pieceMap (create-index order) before the standalone varnode arena.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: The target functions have no explicit local accumulator. PcodeOpBank uniqid advances exactly once per created replacement and SeqNum time is observed; createOps followCount is reset to zero each retry, incremented only for still-pending insertions, and terminates at zero; BlockBasic::insert assigns SeqNum order as ordafter/2+ordbefore/2 and, when ordafter-ordbefore<=1, BlockBasic::setOrder renumbers every op in list order with step=(~0/size)-1, after which midpoint insertion resumes; Varnode create indices advance only for bank-resident varnodes (NULL input slots create none).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The decisive branch keys are exact opcode equality with CPUI_MULTIEQUAL, follow->follow completion state, special-bit membership (op_preexisting / indirect_creation / indirect_creation_possible_out) and isIndirectZero flag equality. No container sort is performed; final order is determined by BlockBasic insertion position, while the fixture compares opcode, SeqNum time/order, indirect_creation flags, identity, def-use and counts without re-sorting.

overlay.policy: The only live library-source input; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base transform.rs

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus one verified transform.rs overlay; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: Eleven isolated function shells (four BfdArchitecture shells over immutable 34a3febf:examples/curl for the original records plus seven more for the residual branches; Rugra mirrors each with a fresh Funcdata). No followFlow and no Action pass; one synthetic BlockBasic per case and one integrated outputless COPY anchor per block
analysis_options.placeholder_construction: Immediate cases create two newOpReplace placeholders against the same anchor. Follow cases create one immediate COPY replacement followed by newOp placeholders sharing it. The nested case chains top->mid->follow. Preexisting cases call newPreexistingOp on already-inserted ops with mismatched input counts (shrink 3->1 and grow 1->3). INDIRECT cases build a preexisting CPUI_INDIRECT, mark it via markIndirectCreation(possible), and inherit through TransformOp::inheritIndirect. The error case installs a preserveAddress override (cf. SubfloatFlow) and calls newPiece(bitSize=8, lsbOffset=4). Every generated op has a unique output and fixed constant inputs except the deliberately output-less and the preexisting ops
analysis_options.case_matrix: createReplacement immediate, follow, nested-follow and preexisting arms crossed with CPUI_MULTIEQUAL, CPUI_COPY and CPUI_INDIRECT; specialHandling both flag arms; misaligned-piece LowlevelError with pre-exception partial state; output==nullptr arm; SeqNum midpoint exhaustion forcing BlockBasic::setOrder
analysis_options.error_injection: misaligned TransformVar::piece forces LowlevelError("Varnode piece is not byte aligned") mid-createVarnodes; the fixture captures the message and the partial state
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG and TYPEPROP_DEBUG absent
analysis_options.diagnostics: BfdArchitecture initialization diagnostics captured privately and excluded from the target API observation
analysis_options.normalization: Only raw unique-space offsets and process pointer values are omitted. Stable vN/oN encounter labels preserve all aliasing; opcode, SeqNum time/order, PcodeOp::indirect_creation and Varnode::indirect_creation flags, NULL input slots, parent, create index, size, space index, constant value, def-use and counts are byte-compared

cases.expected_error: Varnode piece is not byte aligned

observation_schema.format: Eleven fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.op_projection: Exact block order, opcode, SeqNum time/order, parent index, PcodeOp::indirect_creation flag, output identity (or null) and ordered input identities (or NULL slot underscores in pre-placeInputs partial state)
observation_schema.varnode_projection: First-encounter identity, create index, size, address-space index, constant value, Varnode::indirect_creation flag, defining op and ordered descendant ops; NULL-slot sentinels are excluded
observation_schema.count_projection: block ops, projected varnodes, alive/dead/all bank ops and total Funcdata varnodes
observation_schema.anchor_projection: Original anchor dead state and parent detachment; piece_error additionally projects the captured LowlevelError message
observation_schema.preserved: No order, alias, control-flow, identity or count field is normalized; only unique offsets and raw pointers are intentionally absent

replacement_multiequal_begin_order.covers: createReplacement immediate path with two CPUI_MULTIEQUAL replacements, including reversed block-begin order

follow_multiequal_begin_order.covers: attemptInsertion follow path with two CPUI_MULTIEQUAL ops sharing one completed follow

replacement_nonphi_order.covers: createReplacement immediate non-PHI control with two CPUI_COPY replacements retaining creation order

follow_nonphi_order.covers: attemptInsertion follow non-PHI control with two CPUI_COPY ops retaining before-follow creation order

identity_and_counts.covers: all records compare op/varnode identity, aliases, SeqNum time/order, indirect_creation flags, parent, def-use and block/bank counts

op_preexisting_resize_path.covers: createReplacement op_preexisting arm (transform.cc:228-237) on two already-inserted ops: opcode retarget, input shrink 3->1 (removeInput from the last slot plus opUnsetInput clearing), grow 1->3 (two NULL-slot opInsertInput calls at numInput()-1 later overwritten by placeInputs), replacement identity/position/output retention and no opDestroy

nested_follow_chain.covers: attemptInsertion with a two-hop follow chain top(COPY)->mid(MULTIEQUAL)->follow(COPY): mid resolves first at block begin, then top inserts before mid's replacement, proving the follow->replacement indirection; single-pass convergence (the do-while retry body is unreachable through the public newOp API because follow pointers always reference earlier-created placeholders - creation-order invariant holds on both sides)

indirect_special_handling.covers: inheritIndirect both arms (indirect_zero -> indirect_creation, otherwise indirect_creation_possible_out) and specialHandling -> Funcdata::markIndirectCreation(false/true): replacement op gains PcodeOp::indirect_creation, output gains Varnode::indirect_creation, input(0) gains it only in the non-possible-out form; opInsertBefore's preceding-INDIRECT skip arm (non-INDIRECT follow replacement before the marked INDIRECT) and non-skip arm (the new INDIRECT itself)

insertion_error_paths.covers: misaligned TransformVar::piece (preserveAddress override forcing piece-hood, cf. SubfloatFlow::preserveAddress subflow.cc:3451) throws LowlevelError('Varnode piece is not byte aligned') during createVarnodes; the pre-exception partial state is compared: replacement op created and inserted with NULL input slots, output Varnode materialized, no input placement, removeOld not run, anchor alive

create_replacement_output_null.covers: createReplacement output==nullptr arm (transform.cc:241-242): a zero-input CPUI_COPY and a two-input CPUI_MULTIEQUAL replacement are created, inserted and input-wired with no output Varnode materialized

blockbasic_setorder_renumber_boundary.covers: BlockBasic::insert SeqNum midpoint exhaustion (block.cc:2280-2283): 25 CPUI_MULTIEQUAL begin-insertions walk the ordbefore=2 ladder down to a gap of 1, forcing BlockBasic::setOrder (block.cc:2638-2651, step=171798690 over the 25-op block) mid-sequence, after which midpoint assignment resumes - observable through the full r-value vector

out_of_scope_observations.note: Ghidra Funcdata::markIndirectCreation (funcdata_op.cc:736-748) throws LowlevelError('Indirect creation not properly formed') when input(0) is non-constant; Rugra Funcdata::mark_indirect_creation (src/funcdata.rs) logs to stderr and continues. Not exercised here (all INDIRECT inputs are constants); src/funcdata.rs is outside this fixture's write-set.

Ghidra's PcodeOp ctor (op.cc:71, inrefs(s)) pre-sizes input slots to NULL; Rugra PcodeOpBank::create (src/op.rs) only reserves capacity. src/transform.rs pre-fills detached size-0 sentinels to preserve numInput; the underlying op.rs gap is compensated, not fixed.

LanedRegister::parseSizes throws LowlevelError('Bad lane size') (transform.cc:323-324); Rugra parse_sizes logs and skips. Placeholder-construction-time path with no mid-apply partial state; outside this fixture's six branches.
getPiece duplicate-piece mismatch throws LowlevelError (transform.cc:607); Rugra logs and returns the first piece. Construction-time path; belongs to a placeholder-construction fixture family.

createOps' do-while retry body (transform.cc:673-679) requires follow->follow != null at processing time; follow chains built via newOp always reference earlier-created placeholders and resolve within the first pass on both sides (creation-order invariant), so retry re-entry has no oracle-observable input through the public API.
